title: A £1m loan: what is lost on default
caption: If the borrower defaults, 40% is recovered and 60% (LGD) is lost: £600,000 of the £1,000,000. With a 2% chance of default the expected loss is 0.02 × £600,000 = £12,000.
alt: One bar for the £1,000,000 loan split into £600,000 lost and £400,000 recovered.
description: On default £600,000 is lost and £400,000 recovered.
